requirements: Blender, run from a Python script the agent writes; no downloaded assets.
A PC with a decent GPU to render 1080x1920 at 30 fps (the creator suggests asking Claude first whether yours can handle it).

preview.description: A 35-45 second vertical 3D short made in Blender from Python: someone presses the button on an everyday machine, the camera dives inside, and a team of tiny capybara workers sketches, paints, dries and delivers the result by hand.
